items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And the René Brothers was writing the music -- Otis René and what's the other one --

ctx.x: And I would keep his wife company while he was gone.

So during that time, Flournoy Miller tried to produce another show, called 'Slim Pickins', at the Wilshire Ebell. And we'd rehearse for I don't know how long. And the René Brothers was writing the music -- Otis René and what's the other one --
